rulings.ruling: Ruling: equivalent representation; project retained. Both enter zero unless the loan and vehicle qualify; both use the interest as reported when nothing nonqualifying was financed, and otherwise allocate it pro rata (refinancing by the refinanced balance over the new loan, a mixed loan by the qualifying part over the loan, ratios to six places). The guards are ordered differently and give the same value for every kind of loan. Column (ii) is zero in both (Schedules C, E and F are refused).
